prompts.center: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated furniture sprite for a cozy Korean room game. Create one standalone square oak end-table cabinet: plain thick square top, two full flat side panels, low solid plinth, one completely empty open front cubby with a wooden back. No drawer, no handle, no doors, no books or decorations. Physical proportions width 65cm, depth 45cm, height 60cm. Preserve the original warm pale honey oak grain and soft cream daylight, polished storybook 3D illustration, not harsh photorealism. CENTER FRONT VIEW: camera directly in front, all upright edges vertical, front fully visible, just a little top visible, no visible side. Whole object centered, level grounded base, clear empty margins on all four sides. Render a single object on genuine transparent alpha background, no floor, no external shadow, no room, no UI, no text, no people, no sofa, no plants. Output square 1024x1024. This is the center view; other angles will be generated independently later.
